QuestInfo.name: No Questions Asked
QuestInfo.0: #b#p437##k won't give out names for free.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p437##k's runner lost his ledger in the Hollow, and #r#o56#s#k grabbed the pages. If I bring back #b20 #t4031143#s#k from #b#m010006020##k and #b#m010006040##k, he will tell me who sells him fairy goods.
QuestInfo.2: I brought #b#p437##k his ledger pages. He told me his best supplier is a young thief named #b#p438##k.

0.0: You want a name? Names cost money. ...But maybe you can pay me another way.
0.1: Last week my runner was carrying my ledger through the Hollow. Every deal I've ever made is written in it. Then a swarm of #r#o56#s#k came after him.
0.2: He made it out. My ledger didn't. Those things grab anything that shines, even fresh ink. Now the pages are all over #b#m010006020##k and #b#m010006040##k.
0.3: Bring back #b20 #t4031143#s#k. That ledger proves I'm more than a small-time fence. If a rival finds it first, I'm finished.

yes.0: Good. Look for #r#o56#s#k in #b#m010006020##k and #b#m010006040##k. And don't read the pages. ...Fine, read them. Just don't tell anyone.

no.0: Then we have nothing to talk about. Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: All twenty pages! You're better at this than my runner.
1.1: A deal is a deal. My best supplier is a girl named #b#p438##k. She's young, but she brings me the best goods in Kerning City.
1.2: She knows a secret way into the Hollow. I've never asked how. In my business, you don't ask questions.

item.0: Still missing pages. I need #b20 #t4031143#s#k. The #r#o56#s#k in #b#m010006020##k and #b#m010006040##k have them.
